sql: WITH t AS (SELECT split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) AS series, split_part(market_ticker,'-',1)||':'||split_part(market_ticker,'-',2) AS contest, market_ticker AS mkt, strategy, created_at, (pnl/quantity)*100 AS c, CASE WHEN coalesce(side,'no')='no' THEN 100-assumed_price ELSE assumed_price END AS entry FROM paper_trades WHERE status = ANY(ARRAY['settled','closed_sl']) AND NOT coalesce(legacy,false) AND pnl IS NOT NULL AND quantity>0 AND assumed_price IS NOT NULL AND strategy LIKE '%%mmsell%%' AND strategy NOT IN (SELECT twin_tag FROM live_paper_twins) AND split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) = ANY(ARRAY['KXNFLSPREAD','KXMLBSPREAD','KXRAIN','KXTRUMPSAY','KXWTI','KXALBUMEQUIV','KXMLBHR','KXNFLTOTAL','KXITFMATCH','KXBTCD'])) SELECT series, count(*) AS trades, count(DISTINCT contest) AS contests, count(DISTINCT mkt) AS mkts, count(DISTINCT strategy) AS books, round(avg(entry)::numeric,1) AS entry_c, round(avg(c)::numeric,3) AS cents_per_trade, round(sum(c)/100.0::numeric,2) AS total_usd, round((100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE c<0)/count(*))::numeric,1) AS loss_pct, round(avg(c) FILTER (WHERE c>0)::numeric,1) AS avg_win, round(avg(c) FILTER (WHERE c<0)::numeric,1) AS avg_loss, min(created_at)::date AS first, max(created_at)::date AS last, round((count(*)::numeric/GREATEST(1,(max(created_at)::date-min(created_at)::date)))::numeric,1) AS trades_per_day FROM t GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
